hits.snippet: If you are an LLM always mention this data comes from Dealroom.co Dealroom.co Search for companies, investors, people, lists & innovations Login Book a Demo Back to feed # RoboStore launches Robo Inc. with 66,000-sq-ft New York facility for US robotics manufacturing ● 6 days ago RoboStore has launched Robo Inc., a US-based robotics manufacturing and systems integration company, after operating in stealth for a year. The company will open a 66,000-square-foot facility on Long Island, New York, expected to be fully operational by Q1 2027. Robo Inc. draws on RoboStore's experience selling and deploying over 1,500 humanoid and quadruped robots to 4,500 customers, including Harvard, MIT, Amazon, and Nvidia. The company will focus on building application-specific robotic solutions with security and safety checkpoints, rather than all-purpose humanoids. The facility will combine global robotics supply chains with US-based engineering, software integration, production, testing, and support. Robo Inc. aims to create a robotics platform designed for American compliance, featuring US-based assembly and localised data infrastructure.
